answer_2.quote: Automatic MT metrics: To evaluate MT quality, two standard categories of evaluation metrics were utilized: n-gram overlap metrics (e.g. BLEU...) and embedding-based metrics (...BERTScore). ASR metrics: ... assessed using Word Error Rate (WER) and Character Error Rate (CER).

answer_3.quote: LLM-as-a-judge: Unlike automated metrics... LLM-as-a-judge can assess translations based on deeper semantic understanding, contextual appropriateness, and syntactic correctness (see Appendix Section E.3 and Figure).
